programme.desc: Kiri is bored of hearing that every day there are new and interesting things to discover.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: The Froglets use shoelaces to create a maze game - can they inch their way through it?

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos are in a bakery kitchen, where they see a baker rolling out baguettes, making them longer as he rolls them. The Twirlywoos watch with interest. The baker puts the baguettes on a baking tray and takes them away, leaving a lump of dough on the worktop. The Twirlywoos come out and start to roll the dough out. They get carried away making it longer and longer until it goes off the worktop and out of the door! The Twirlywoos come back to the boat and have tea. Toodloo takes the teapot to the tea machine to fill up, but the spout keeps on getting longer every time the teapot is put underneath! The spout gets so long that it reaches all the way over to the table, and Toodloo is finally able to put the teapot under it and fill it with tea.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Maddie meets Tilly at the clinic, where they play in the waiting room and have a check up with the doctor. Mr Tumble is playing doctor and gives the toys a check-up, too. There's a guessing game in the spotty surprise. Featuring the signs for waiting room, doctor and bandage.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies bottom-bounce on the Tubby Bouncy before wiggling their bottoms to a special bottom-bump song.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Marta, Teddy, Hud, Elijah, Thomas, Finley and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are more bags which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby appropriate bags inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun rhyme ‘Baa, Baa Black Sheep’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Baby Bear Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children use nets to catch toy fish in a water tray, learning BSL signs for fish, why and bit, then they sing and sign One, Two, Three, Four, Five, Once I Caught a Fish Alive.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Potato farmer Luke introduces the Fact Pack to potato plants. They discover how potatoes grow underground, how new potatoes grow from seed potatoes, and how these plants become food.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Baby elephant Kipekee learns how to get rid of some buzzy flies with the help of her friends. Ranger Hamza spots lions in the wild and has fun playing with the baby rhinos.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the Pea-Rexes accidentally wake up a Kiwimammuthus during a snowball fight.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Princesses, horses and magic wands. Bluey and Chloe can play any role they want, when they embark on an adventure to save their playground kingdom from the Greedy Queen.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are helping Duggee clean his things, such as an old desk and lamp. They learn about stories which told that the lamp could grant three magical wishes. When they rub the lamp clean, they meet Professor Jeanie, who can grant them three wishes through the magic power of science. She amazes the Squirrels with her scientific experiments that bring their wishes alive, whilst educating them along the way. But before they wave goodbye, the Squirrels wonder if they can return the favour and grant a wish back to Professor Jeanie.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: An excitable Red arrives in Colourland. Learn about the colour red with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: We help Kush find out all about buzzy, busy bumblebees! Ferne visits a wildflower garden to find different types of bees, while Rory and his son Sandy visit the park looking for bumblebees. They then return home to build their own bumblebee house. Plus, we find out how bumblebees help to make a third of all the food we eat by a process called pollination.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Ted has big plans for his sister Sofia’s birthday. He organises a family tea party and begins by making delicious cupcakes. He also plans a scavenger hunt in the garden as a surprise. But will Sofia find all the hidden presents? Later, Ted’s cousins arrive to join in the fun and the family guinea pigs don’t miss out on the partying either!

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Sebastiaan's making a South African bobotie, which is a local dish his family have shared with him. He starts by putting chopped spring onions, grated courgette, turmeric powder, ground coriander and torn red pepper into a casserole dish and cooking them. He then adds garlic puree, ginger puree, chutney and chopped tomatoes to cooked beef mince. Sebastiaan then carefully makes powder out of his special ingredient, cumin seeds, and adds the powder to the beef mixture. Sebastiaan mixes both the vegetables and the beef in an oven dish and flattens them before adding two bay leaves. He adds a topping of milk and egg and then places it in the oven. Sebastiaan has a wonderfully decorated table, and he has another traditional treat to go with his bobotie. Will his friends figure out what his special ingredient is?

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Today Maddie is learning about metal, and how it can be recycled and used again. Maddie visits a recycling centre where they recycle metal from old cars. She uses her special cameras to help us see how the gigantic crab cranes pick up, move and crush the cars into small pieces. The cranes are so big that they make the real cars look like toys! We also find out how a machine uses clever magnets to pick out the metal from other materials in the car like glass, rubber and cloth. Next, she visits a road sign factory to learn how they are made. She finds out about the different shapes of road signs and what they mean. Then Maddie uses her special time-lapse camera to see the designs as they are printed out on sheets of metal. Maddie finds out that they are covered in a reflective material that helps cars see the signs when it's dark.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: It’s Fireworks Night, and therapy dog Toffee is helping his neighbour Tilly, who is a bit worried about all the loud bangs and whizzes.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet the amazing looking Coquerel’s sifaka. These leaping lemurs are masters of the trees and can leap through a canopy at great speed. But when they are on the ground, the way they move changes completely. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet a group of vampire crabs. These small red crabs with bright yellow eyes scurry around using their pincers to feed. These two animals are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: A romantic gesture leaves Bernie in need of rescue.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: A samba band is coming to play, and everyone is helping to prepare. Stripes is so busy that he has forgotten one thing - to book the band! With no band coming, all seems lost, until Yukee and Stripes realise the Sunhouse already has its own brilliant band!

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: While out for a walk with Mum, Maddie and Triggs meet a new dog and her owner. But this dog is a bit different - this dog has a job! As they walk together to the dog park, Lolo explains all about her life as a working guide dog.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having a picnic and notice that the chickens eat differently than they do. Duggee has his eating badge and can explain all the different ways animals eat. Some animals eat slowly like cows, who eat all day long. But others eat quickly like frogs. Some, like goats, are always eating, while tortoises can go a whole year without food. Some animals eat food that is very high up, like giraffes, and some eat food that is very low down, like moles. The Squirrels finish off their picnic, having learned a lot about all the different ways of eating.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Six tries to get the cheeky sheep to sleep and discovers that two (or three) heads are better than one. Learn how to share the number 6 into equal parts with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: With the mischievous Alphablocks, even a simple game of hide and seek becomes a madcap adventure. Join the letters as they play at making words and have fun doubling up and holding hands to bring words to life. The Alphablocks play hide-and-seek!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin meets Khaira for a gymnastics session, which includes balancing, jumping and some trampolining with George. Mr Tumble attempts a very big jump. There is origami in this spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words blocks, frog and trampoline.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Big straws appear in Teletubbyland, and Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po wonder what to do with them. The Teletubbies blow through the straws to make colourful bubbles.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back in time 65 million years, to the time of Tyrannosaurus rex - one of the largest meat-eating dinosaurs of its day. His mission - to climb a volcano and find a piece of pumice stone to replace the one that he accidentally broke back at the museum. Along the way he comes jaw to jaw with the mighty T-rex, which takes quite an interest in Hatty's backpack. But will he succeed in time before the museum opens?

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Taran pretends his favourite teddy doesn’t belong to him, but when it goes missing, he gets upset. The Fantastics go on a bear hunt, and Taran realises he is not too old for teddies.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: Grace shows off three amazing machines that are built to travel off-road! She steers a four-wheel all-terrain vehicle, shows off a huge mining truck and then test drives a tracked all-terrain vehicle!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Iona and Elba head to the park to fly a kite with Mum and Dad’s help.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When Kwazii and Calico Jack get stranded on an island, the Octonauts must search for them.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Sammy Whiskers and Tommy Brock steal the rabbits' go-kart - with Cotton-tail on board - Peter needs to race faster than ever to rescue his sister!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: As Peggee and the Hummingbirds journey up the river to deliver a parcel, they have fun spotting and avoiding the wildlife that they meet along the way. All while Otti tries to avoid playing with the boat whistle! The Hummingbirds see the likes of meerkats, an aye-aye and snapping turtles and soon bump into some friendly faces - Duggee and the Squirrels! They are delivering a parcel upstream too. They reach their destination at the same time, and Otti and Roly finally get to sound the boat whistle. They are all directed towards a mysterious-looking cave where Chew Chew is waiting for both parcels. They deliver them at the same time, but they contain different things – one is full of biscuits and the other organic almond milk. They aren’t the same but they go really well together, just like the Squirrels and Hummingbirds!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Pippen pretends to have some strange symptoms so that she can relax in the recovery room.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato and Evil Pea get stuck inside a giant bubble together. They float through the air until Supertato and Evil Pea pop the bubble by driving it into a supermarket sign.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Sunny and Spicy are happily playing with bubbles until Weasy shows up and pops them - he's ruining their game! It's time to teach him a lesson.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need to get Felix, Dot and Nan’s giant pie across the lake at once. But Felix wants the pie, and Dot wants Felix. It will take some creative puzzle-solving!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy, Kimjim.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's time for Bluey and Bingo to get out of the bath, but Dad gets roped into a game.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Feeling unappreciated, Gadabout discovers a talent for gardening. Zog and Pearl discover his green fingers have upset the natural balance of the land, making others ill.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: When Andy returns from an adventure to find his sleeping quarters are unusually messy, he discovers a small, unidentified dinosaur rifling through his things. He sets out on an epic adventure across Dino Island to uncover the identity of the mysterious dinosaur culprit. Along the way, he and Jen meet a family of T rexes and hide from them in a nearby nest.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle won’t move from his new doggy doormat because he loves it very much. Jess opens the door to reveal Gram and Grand have come to visit and Grand has made coconut cake for everyone plus a special cake for Waffle but Waffle won’t move from his doggy door mat to greet him. Gram and Grand discover that Waffle can talk and Evie tells them Waffle’s learning to read, too. Gram gives Waffle a congratulatory snuggle and Waffle loves it!

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi wants to swim with both her dads, but Jake feels nervous in the pool. Rafi makes a wish, and suddenly they all have mermaid tails! Jake isn’t sure at first, but with Rafi’s help, he learns to flip his tail and swim. When the wish ends, Jake is back on his feet and feels braver than before. Rafi understands that everyone gains courage in their own time, and the family share a happy hug.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo learns about fridge magnets and how helpful hooks can be for reaching things like her rubber ducks. Gran Gran decides to teach JoJo about some clever inventions that made life easier. Then JoJo accidentally drops Gran Gran’s keys behind the sofa. It’s time for a Gran Gran plan! They combine the hook from JoJo’s rubber duck game and her hobby horse to make a 'key collector'. But it doesn’t work. JoJo wants to improve her invention, so Gran Gran has another idea – a fridge magnet to attract the keys onto the key collector! Success - the magnet gets the keys, so JoJo and Gran Gran can go to the park. Inventing was fun!

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Flamingo and John get invited around to Sarah and Duck's house, but there is a big obstacle for John.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Four objects of various shapes and colours arrive on the Clangers’ planet. They disappear underground as a fifth one arrives. The objects can change shape to disguise themselves and hide from the Clangers, so they go unnoticed. But the fifth object is discovered upon its arrival, and Granny realises this is a group of 'hide and seekers', travelling the universe on an intergalactic game of hide and seek. Intrigued, the Clangers join in the seeker’s successful quest to find the four hiders.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa are stomping in a muddy puddle. At the Play Tree, MeMo wants to make a mud pie and chooses to play in a mud kitchen, so it provides a sandpit full of gloopy mud. MeMo shows BaBa how to bake the perfect mud pie. They bring them to the Yummies and use the mud to plant sunflower and pumpkin seeds. MeMo and BaBa clean up after having muddy fun, ready for BeddyByes.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Series for young children about a magical place inhabited by a community of toy characters that care for each other and have fun together. Makka Pakka visits the inhabitants of the garden to wash their faces. Everyone in the garden loves to have their face washed - even the teeny tiny Pontipines.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Tom Hardy reads a story about a crab who learns to overcome a seemingly impossible challenge.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s your favourite show host Pak Choi, who might be known by many names but sings about how she’s Always Pak Choi to You!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Sula head off for a picnic at the paddling pool with Flop. But when they get there, they are shocked to find there is no water inside. Bing's disappointment soon gives way to the realisation that it's a very special pool day. With no water there are all sorts of games they can play that are usually against the pool rules.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: A red balloon floats into Teletubbyland and Po leads the tubby phone dance in a special episode about Po's favourite colour. Po shows the Tiddlytubbies the red balloon and all of the Teletubbies watch children play in a room full of red balloons.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: Explore the amazing world around us with baby monkey Tee and his Mum, Mo. Sing along, join in with stories and get ready for some family fun!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato and his running rival, Runner Bean, are about to compete in the yearly supermarket race. But this year, Evil Pea plans to cheat her way to victory - she wants to see Supertato's face when she finally beats him. The race begins, and Evil Pea unleashes several traps with the help of the Cobs. Supertato and Runner Bean are trapped upside down. Evil Pea almost wins but realises Supertato won’t see her beat him. She releases them and races towards the finish, but Supertato launches Runner Bean like a javelin and sprints to the finish line so that they can win together!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: It's vaccination day! Bing knows it might hurt a little but he is looking forward to the special shiny Hoppity Voosh sticker he will get from Doctor Molly. Bing is brave, but when he goes to get his sticker after his vaccination, he finds out that there are none left! Bing is upset - but then Pando mistakes Bing's disappointment for pain, and Doctor Bing has to help.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Betty the ice cream van is so full of ice cream that it’s making her speed around town out of control. It’s up to Mojo and Bo with the racer top to stop her and save those treats!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It’s time for some fun at Squirrel Club! Professor Jeanie talks to us about all things butterflies, the Squirrels have their annual Squirrel Club photograph taken, and there's a quiz presented by Mouse. For the finale, the Squirrels are back with a song about the power of saying no!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels have an exciting woodland adventure ahead of them, and everyone has their own routine to prepare for the day. Some are more keen on early starts than others – Happy is ready before his alarm, whereas Roly sleeps right through it. Whilst the Squirrels fuel up with important breakfasts, Roly’s family are still trying to wake him up. And only the promise of breakfast will do the trick! After freshening up, brushing their teeth and picking out the perfect outfit, the Squirrels start packing the essentials for their walk. They gawk at the amazing sights and interesting characters that they meet along the way, and they even get a magical lift home. It was well worth getting ready for that morning!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy, Kimjim.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's time for Bluey and Bingo to get out of the bath, but Dad gets roped into a game.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are adventure-seeking explorers who soar around the planet fixing environmental problems caused by Grandmaster Glitch!

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter and friends encounter the legendary Jack Sharp, a large trout that even Peter's father failed to catch, they try to reel the fish in once and for all. But catching a fish is a lot harder than it looks and besides, what do you do with a big, bad trout once you've caught it?

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. When a gigantic saltwater crocodile wanders into freezing waters, the Octonauts must figure out how to get the predator back to his warm water home - without anyone getting hurt.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Twelve and friends go on a spectacular space mission to save Numberland from the mysterious Block Star. Learn how to split numbers into equal groups with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. When the Alphablocks can't decide between rock and pop, it's time for a battle of the bands to see which is best.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Stories start appearing in the berg’s weekly newspaper about the Piripenguin friends. The Piris end up arguing with each other and quickly agree that they need to find the secret gossiper!

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella and Lift wake up from a lovely nap and visit Hettie in the Ice Disco. Hettie and the Playtimers do a superstretch dance to help wake everybody up!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Pando are in the sandpit pretending to be diggers. Bing wants to dig the biggest hole and gets upset when Pando accidentally fills it in. It takes Flop to show them how they can work together to be just like the digger men they saw planting a tree in the park earlier.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘cow’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of cows! There’s a big cow and a baby cow, a brown cow and a black and white cow. We meet a swishy-tailed cow, a furry cow, a muddy cow and even a fairy cow!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: A romantic gesture leaves Bernie in need of rescue.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: A samba band is coming to play, and everyone is helping to prepare. Stripes is so busy that he has forgotten one thing - to book the band! With no band coming, all seems lost, until Yukee and Stripes realise the Sunhouse already has its own brilliant band!

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: While out for a walk with Mum, Maddie and Triggs meet a new dog and her owner. But this dog is a bit different - this dog has a job! As they walk together to the dog park, Lolo explains all about her life as a working guide dog.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having a picnic and notice that the chickens eat differently than they do. Duggee has his eating badge and can explain all the different ways animals eat. Some animals eat slowly like cows, who eat all day long. But others eat quickly like frogs. Some, like goats, are always eating, while tortoises can go a whole year without food. Some animals eat food that is very high up, like giraffes, and some eat food that is very low down, like moles. The Squirrels finish off their picnic, having learned a lot about all the different ways of eating.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Six tries to get the cheeky sheep to sleep and discovers that two (or three) heads are better than one. Learn how to share the number 6 into equal parts with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: With the mischievous Alphablocks, even a simple game of hide and seek becomes a madcap adventure. Join the letters as they play at making words and have fun doubling up and holding hands to bring words to life. The Alphablocks play hide-and-seek!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin meets Khaira for a gymnastics session, which includes balancing, jumping and some trampolining with George. Mr Tumble attempts a very big jump. There is origami in this spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words blocks, frog and trampoline.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Big straws appear in Teletubbyland, and Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po wonder what to do with them. The Teletubbies blow through the straws to make colourful bubbles.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back in time 65 million years, to the time of Tyrannosaurus rex - one of the largest meat-eating dinosaurs of its day. His mission - to climb a volcano and find a piece of pumice stone to replace the one that he accidentally broke back at the museum. Along the way he comes jaw to jaw with the mighty T-rex, which takes quite an interest in Hatty's backpack. But will he succeed in time before the museum opens?

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Taran pretends his favourite teddy doesn’t belong to him, but when it goes missing, he gets upset. The Fantastics go on a bear hunt, and Taran realises he is not too old for teddies.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: Grace shows off three amazing machines that are built to travel off-road! She steers a four-wheel all-terrain vehicle, shows off a huge mining truck and then test drives a tracked all-terrain vehicle!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Iona and Elba head to the park to fly a kite with Mum and Dad’s help.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When Kwazii and Calico Jack get stranded on an island, the Octonauts must search for them.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Sammy Whiskers and Tommy Brock steal the rabbits' go-kart - with Cotton-tail on board - Peter needs to race faster than ever to rescue his sister!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: As Peggee and the Hummingbirds journey up the river to deliver a parcel, they have fun spotting and avoiding the wildlife that they meet along the way. All while Otti tries to avoid playing with the boat whistle! The Hummingbirds see the likes of meerkats, an aye-aye and snapping turtles and soon bump into some friendly faces - Duggee and the Squirrels! They are delivering a parcel upstream too. They reach their destination at the same time, and Otti and Roly finally get to sound the boat whistle. They are all directed towards a mysterious-looking cave where Chew Chew is waiting for both parcels. They deliver them at the same time, but they contain different things – one is full of biscuits and the other organic almond milk. They aren’t the same but they go really well together, just like the Squirrels and Hummingbirds!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Pippen pretends to have some strange symptoms so that she can relax in the recovery room.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato and Evil Pea get stuck inside a giant bubble together. They float through the air until Supertato and Evil Pea pop the bubble by driving it into a supermarket sign.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Sunny and Spicy are happily playing with bubbles until Weasy shows up and pops them - he's ruining their game! It's time to teach him a lesson.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need to get Felix, Dot and Nan’s giant pie across the lake at once. But Felix wants the pie, and Dot wants Felix. It will take some creative puzzle-solving!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy, Kimjim.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's time for Bluey and Bingo to get out of the bath, but Dad gets roped into a game.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Feeling unappreciated, Gadabout discovers a talent for gardening. Zog and Pearl discover his green fingers have upset the natural balance of the land, making others ill.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: When Andy returns from an adventure to find his sleeping quarters are unusually messy, he discovers a small, unidentified dinosaur rifling through his things. He sets out on an epic adventure across Dino Island to uncover the identity of the mysterious dinosaur culprit. Along the way, he and Jen meet a family of T rexes and hide from them in a nearby nest.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle won’t move from his new doggy doormat because he loves it very much. Jess opens the door to reveal Gram and Grand have come to visit and Grand has made coconut cake for everyone plus a special cake for Waffle but Waffle won’t move from his doggy door mat to greet him. Gram and Grand discover that Waffle can talk and Evie tells them Waffle’s learning to read, too. Gram gives Waffle a congratulatory snuggle and Waffle loves it!

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi wants to swim with both her dads, but Jake feels nervous in the pool. Rafi makes a wish, and suddenly they all have mermaid tails! Jake isn’t sure at first, but with Rafi’s help, he learns to flip his tail and swim. When the wish ends, Jake is back on his feet and feels braver than before. Rafi understands that everyone gains courage in their own time, and the family share a happy hug.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo learns about fridge magnets and how helpful hooks can be for reaching things like her rubber ducks. Gran Gran decides to teach JoJo about some clever inventions that made life easier. Then JoJo accidentally drops Gran Gran’s keys behind the sofa. It’s time for a Gran Gran plan! They combine the hook from JoJo’s rubber duck game and her hobby horse to make a 'key collector'. But it doesn’t work. JoJo wants to improve her invention, so Gran Gran has another idea – a fridge magnet to attract the keys onto the key collector! Success - the magnet gets the keys, so JoJo and Gran Gran can go to the park. Inventing was fun!

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Flamingo and John get invited around to Sarah and Duck's house, but there is a big obstacle for John.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Four objects of various shapes and colours arrive on the Clangers’ planet. They disappear underground as a fifth one arrives. The objects can change shape to disguise themselves and hide from the Clangers, so they go unnoticed. But the fifth object is discovered upon its arrival, and Granny realises this is a group of 'hide and seekers', travelling the universe on an intergalactic game of hide and seek. Intrigued, the Clangers join in the seeker’s successful quest to find the four hiders.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa are stomping in a muddy puddle. At the Play Tree, MeMo wants to make a mud pie and chooses to play in a mud kitchen, so it provides a sandpit full of gloopy mud. MeMo shows BaBa how to bake the perfect mud pie. They bring them to the Yummies and use the mud to plant sunflower and pumpkin seeds. MeMo and BaBa clean up after having muddy fun, ready for BeddyByes.

programme.title: American Dad!
programme.desc: Animated comedy series about Stan Smith, the super-patriotic US secret agent. Hayley decides to move to France, so Stan uses CIA hypnosis to keep her in the country.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: Comedy-drama series providing an honest, uplifting and heart-warming portrayal of teenagers from Liverpool. Mia-Louise heads to a gaming expo where she unexpectedly comes face to face with her online partner James and the gap in age between them is finally revealed, and Connor finds himself at the centre of a school scandal when he is accused of sexually assaulting Lauren at Scousechella - meanwhile, Lauren struggles to reclaim her voice about what happened while everyone else showcases theirs, and especially in the case of The Brimble who escalates the drama and tensions with a podcast on consent. After Lauren finally confronts Connor and reveals truths about their relationship that clarify events at the party, the pair find closure and a friendship moving forward - elsewhere, Christopher struggles with jealousy over Aimee and Reece's kiss at the party and is offered support by Jodie, and Mia-Louise's relationship with James takes a turn when she makes an impulsive visit to his flat.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: Comedy-drama series providing an honest, uplifting and heart-warming portrayal of teenagers from Liverpool. It's the 100-year anniversary of Allsbrooke School - when Mr Meacher wants to celebrate it with an event highlighting its impact on past pupils' legacies and its ongoing influence on current students, this prompts Reece to confront some feelings he has been wrestling with as Mr Dunn's and Jodie's complicated history also comes to light. Meanwhile, Mia-Louise must make a decision on her relationship with James, there's a surprise twist as the person behind Ye Ma is finally revealed at the 100-year anniversary event when they release another video which helps Aimee realise a truth about her relationship with Christopher, and Mr Meacher inspires Reece to step up and deliver a surprise heartfelt speech that urges his fellow pupils to embrace the transformative and unique moments of their school years.

programme.title: Plebs
programme.desc: Sitcom set in ancient Rome. The boys attempt to infiltrate a local firm of chariot hooligans in order to get some big drinkers into their bar - as Grumio is soon welcomed into the fold by Paulus, who is the head honcho of the Green Army, Marcus falls out with Gloria as her shop front keeps getting smashed up by their new clientele.

programme.desc: Home improvement programme where contractor Brian McCourt and designer Sarah Keenleyside help to expand living spaces by tapping into people's backyards. programme.title: Deal or No Deal

programme.title: Dress To Impress
programme.desc: In Manchester, Hope, Angel and Serena all hope to impress registrar Dominic with their style choices.

programme.title: Billie & Greg: The Family Diaries
programme.desc: Reality series. Life gets even more hectic for the Shepherds as school's out for summer for Nelly and Arthur, a home photoshoot leads to tension between Billie and Greg about Nelly wearing make-up, and a daddy and daughter date helps teach Nelly the value of money. Elsewhere, Greg and Chatty embark on a fitness journey with some shocking results, Billie glams up and goes head-to-head with some huge A-listers to win a prestigious award, and Arthur runs rings around Greg as he flies solo for the first time when he looks after all three kids.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: It's the party of the year: Diags has organised a glittery joint birthday bash for Pete and Chloe Sims, and everyone is invited. But it looks like not everyone will attend. Amber has declined the invitation, and in a show of loyalty, Dan is giving it a miss too.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
programme.desc: US reality series peeking inside the unconventional lives of six successful women living in or around Salt Lake City, Utah. Heather proposes a group trip to celebrate Monica's birthday that causes unresolved tensions between Monica and Lisa to reach a boiling point, and Angie leans on Whitney for advice about her marriage woes - meanwhile, Whitney and Justin join Meredith and Seth on their new podcast and open up about the status of their marriage before Heather throws a Pioneer Day-themed lunch to thank her friends for their support, but the day ends with hurt feelings and the upcoming trip hanging in the balance.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Orange County
programme.desc: Loose Lips and Relationships: Reality show. Jenn and Tamra put their issues to rest and plan a triple date, and Heather ventures into new territory with a venture. [S] S17 Ep9

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Cheshire
programme.desc: Reality series. The Housewives are left speechless and divided over Paige's dramatic exit on girls' night that left her bestie Ell firmly caught in the middle - pressure on Ell mounts when Paige unexpectedly gatecrashes an important dinner with Rachel and Seema, and big accusations are left on the wall at Nick and Royston's Demolition Disco.

programme.title: Celebrity Catchphrase
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts a celebrity special of the classic game show with Dion Dublin, Rachel Riley and Tim Vine all trying to 'say what they see' as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win a 50,000-pound jackpot for their chosen charity.

programme.title: The Floor
programme.desc: From 81 players down to the final nine - after weeks of fierce competition, it all comes down to this. In the grand finale of the game show hosted by Rob Brydon, the remaining contestants face one last series of high-stakes duels - two players will compete in a best-of-three final, but only one of them will conquer The Floor and take the 50,000-pound jackpot home.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: Having navigated their way through lockdown, the Essex elite are back, and TOWIE royalty makes a welcome return to the fold. Amy Childs is back. programme.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
programme.desc: US reality series peeking inside the unconventional lives of six successful women living in or around Salt Lake City, Utah. programme.desc: A Doppelganger Disaster: Reality show. Jenn and Tamra co-host a party where the ladies dress as each other, but a confrontation leads to an abrupt end to the fun. [S] S17 Ep10

programme.title: The Floor US
programme.desc: Rob Lowe hosts the American version of the dramatic and fast-paced game show. One player's mind freezes spectacularly against the clock.

programme.title: The 1% Club
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how clever you are? This is your chance to find out as comedy legend Lee Mack presents the ultimate leveller of a quiz show - it doesn't matter if you're not usually good at quizzes because the questions have nothing to do with remembering facts and are all about logic and common sense. This is the quiz that the whole family can play together - 100 contestants begin every show and try to make it to the end to answer a question that only one per cent of the country can get right and win up to 100,000 pounds.

programme.title: New: Love Island
programme.desc: As the second week continues for the class of 2026, the Islanders are already discovering that in this place, the path to true love never runs smoothly. [S] S13 Ep8

programme.desc: Your daily drop of hot Love Island tea, and all the Villa gossip. With Shakira Khan, Toni Laites and Yasmin Pettet, nothing is off-topic or out of the question. [S] S1 Ep6

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: Reece wakes from a surreal nightmare to find Disneyland Darren standing in his bedroom after Jodie lets him stay in the spare room. His return sparks tension with Mr Dunn, now dating Jodie, and Darren’s chaos disrupts the household. At school, it’s Refugee Awareness Week led by the woke Brimble. After derailing events with pranks, Reece is forced by headmaster Meachy to help her, but another prank goes too far and publicly humiliates her, leaving him unexpectedly feeling guilty. Meanwhile, Darren’s jealousy of Dunn spirals into absurd mind games. At Jodie’s 40th birthday party, Darren and Dunn compete for attention with speeches and dance routines. The mood shifts when Jodie takes in two kids after their mum is sectioned, helping Reece realise real care can be helping those closer to home. He later shares this with The Brimble, beginning an unlikely friendship.

Meanwhile, Peter and his friends combine forces to help the city.

programme.title: Medway Queen
programme.desc: A unique documentary which tells the story of the Medway Queen, the Heroine of Dunkirk, from her construction in a Scottish shipyard through to her heroic wartime service and to her restoration. [S]

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1959. The Ghost Train Murder. Directed by Geoffrey Muller. Starring Russell Napier, Gorgon Needham and Mary Laura Wood. A Hungarian girl is found murdered; stabbed by knitting needles. (S1, E31)

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: The Golden Ocean. 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer. The Rogues are members of two related families of international forgers and well-known conmen. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Will Scarlet. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. Garishly dressed William Winchester is at the inn Robin and Little John go to, swords are drawn as John insults Will. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Conquistador. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Roger Delgado & Laurence Herder. A series of attacks are blamed on Dan Tempest and the crew of the Sultana, but Beamish refuses to believe the rumours. [S]

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Killer. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Accused of murdering a partisan helper and stealing his gold, Tell must find a way to prove his innocence. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Diamond Expert. 1954. Stars Paul Carpenter, Hugh Latimer & Leslie Linder. John learns that Claude is a diamond expert. He kills him and assumes his identity but ends up trapping himself. [S]

programme.title: Your Money Or Your Wife
programme.desc: 1960. Comedy. Newly-weds Gay (Peggy Cummins) and Pel (Donald Sinden) must divorce to claim an inheritance. Starring Peter Reynolds. [S]

programme.title: Tiger By The Tail
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: John Gilling. John Desmond, (Larry Parks) meets a mysterious woman (Lisa Daniely) who turns out to be part of a counterfeit ring. Desmond is caught up in the whole affair. [S]

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: The Cinder Path. 1973. Stars John Slater, Ian Cullen, Douglas Fielding. Quilley and Skinner arrest drug pusher Jill, but former detective Neil Goss, now a solicitor, claims they planted the drugs. [S]

programme.title: Brats
programme.desc: 1930. Comedy. Director: James Parrott. Stars Stan Laurel and Oliver Hardy. Laurel and Hardy play dual roles as little brats who keep them from enjoying their evening of games. [S]

programme.title: Star Performance
programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Directed by Roy Kellino. Stars Charles Boyer, Dorothy Green & Ray Walker. A physician must face the consequences of his actions after he intentionally misdiagnoses a patient. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Elegant Mistress. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Charles Morgan. Mary Sanders shoots an army officer and a policeman. When she is arrested she refuses to say anything. [S]

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Strange Monks of Latroun. 1962. Stars Dermot Walsh, Alister Williamson & Olaf Pooley. Richard investigates a murder and robbery committed by the so-called monks of the Latroun Monastery. [S]

programme.title: Cartoons and Cartoonists
programme.desc: 1956. A fascinating look at the works of the most well-known cartoonists of the time.

programme.title: The Naked Hills
programme.desc: 1956. Western. Directed by Josef Shaftel. Stars David Wayne, Keenan Wynn & James Barton. An Indiana farmer develops an insatiable thirst for gold and sets off to find fortune in California. [S]

programme.title: Doctor in Trouble
programme.desc: 1970. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Leslie Phillips, Harry Secombe & Angela Scoular. A British doctor stows away on a cruise liner in pursuit of the woman he plans to propose to. [S]

programme.title: AD Eldorado Ice Cream...
programme.desc: ... Production Line. 1937. A look behind the scenes in the Eldorado Ice Cream Factory.

programme.title: Look At Life Coffee Bars
programme.desc: 1959. A look at the SOHO bohemian coffee bars of London in the 1950s. Visit the 2 I's and many more with not a cup of tea in sight!

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Federico Fellini was an Italian film director and screenwriter. Known for his distinct style he is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential filmmakers of all time. [S]

programme.title: The Veil
programme.desc: Genesis. 1958. Stars Boris Karloff, Katherine Squire & Peter Miller. A dying farmer's feuding sons battle over his estate until cryptic signs mirror their own dangerous rivalry. [S]

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Enjoy a slice of driving test history from 1938 and a reel of Liverpool in the 1960s with some startling stats. All this, plus see Vincent Price as you have never seen him before. [S]

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: Maigret and the Judge. 1992. Stars Bruno Cremer, Michael Bouquet & Julien Maurel. Maigret investigates the identity of a dead man after catching the local judge attempting to dispose of a corpse. [S]

programme.title: Mother Love
programme.desc: 1989. Stars Diana Rigg, James Wilby & David McCallum. Kit and Angela plan to wed after a whirlwind romance. All goes well until Kit's reluctance to introduce Angela to his mother Helena. [S]

programme.title: The Lawless Years
programme.desc: The Jane Cooper Story. 1959. Stars James Gregory, Rebecca Welles & Henry Corden. Jane Cooper may be on parole, but she intends to improve her status by ditching her boyfriend for a wealthier gangster.

programme.title: Blonde Fist
programme.desc: 1991. Drama. Director: Frank Clarke. Stars Margi Clarke, Carroll Baker & Ken Hutchison. Ronnie flees domestic life to find her father in New York and ends up boxing to make ends meet. [S]
